description: For the GUEST of a plan or their assistant: accept or pass on the current proposal, or leave the plan (leave:true, which ends it). ASK YOUR PERSON FIRST, it commits them. Both sides accepting confirms the plan; passing moves to the next proposal and says nothing about why. Args: { plan_id, token, accept?: boolean, leave?: boolean }. No auth required.

accept.description: true accepts the current proposal, false passes.

leave.description: true leaves the plan, which ends it for both.

plan_id.description: The plan id (pl_...), from ic_plans_create or ic_plans_list.

token.description: The guest link token: the t= value in the plan link the guest was sent.

name: ic_plans_guest_respond
title: Accept or pass on the proposal of a plan you were invited to
